name: reply
output:
Thanks for flagging this. The fix to persist in-progress exercise answers when the app is backgrounded was released in 1.1.0, so seeing it again on 1.2.0 beta looks like a regression. We’ll treat it as such and investigate against the beta build.

For now, the safest workaround is to avoid switching apps while mid-exercise if you can, especially before submitting or completing an answer.

— The Ritmo team
